data_description.position_value_price: If you wish to calculate the position value for an ETF, specify the base price per unit. This price is used for the position value calculation.
data_description.day_month_start_price: This price is used for the calculation of the day & month start values.
data_description.scan_interval: The data retrival interval typically does not matter, as this integration uses a WebSocket connection. However, should this connection fail for an extended period, the data retrival interval will take effect.
data_description.data_update_interval: The HA-Sensor update interval can have negative impact on the overall performance of your HA system (if you select a quite low interval). If you select 1 second, the data will be shown in HA as soon as they arrive via the WebSocket connection. I (marq24) do recommend to use 10sec or higher.
